$comment: The load-budget ratchet (docs/briefs/XP-packs.md, docs/PWA_PACKS.md). qa/pwa/precache.test.mjs asserts the measured initial download and the before-the-tap-prompt load against 'initialMB' and 'tapPromptMB'. Only the agent named in 'stages' may raise 'initialMB' to that stage's value, and only at that stage; 'capMB' (6.5) and 'tapCapMB' (2.5) are Scott's and never move; 'tapPromptMB' never grows after XP-packs. Measures are the test's wire-size measure (text gzipped, png and audio as is), in MiB.

after-X1-integrate.who: X1-integrate (the hub's small edits to five existing maps)

after-X2-integrate.who: X2-integrate (its six small edits to existing maps)
